comment: Advisories `npm audit` reports for the explorer workspace (applications/qnet-explorer, where the lockfile is) that do not reach the running site, each with the reason and an `until` date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC) after which the entry no longer excuses it: a reason that waits for an upgrade expires instead of holding forever. scripts/audit-check.mjs (npm run audit:check, also part of npm run check:release) fails on any other advisory, with or without --omit=dev, and on a release line past its security support (release-support.json); src/lib/__tests__/dependency-audit.test.mjs checks the gate's logic and that each entry keeps a reason and a date. docs/applications/explorer.md, 'Dependency advisories', says the same.

advisories.why: Build tools only: tailwindcss loads its own configuration through sucrase, which lists this repository's files with glob while the stylesheet is built. The running site serves the built CSS and loads neither, and no request, page or route reaches glob. Every glob release from 9.0.0 to 14.0.1 is affected and sucrase 3 requires ^10, so this waits for a sucrase release on a fixed glob.

advisories.path: eslint, @eslint/eslintrc, @eslint/config-array > minimatch 3.1.5; eslint-config-next > @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree, eslint-plugin-import, eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y, eslint-plugin-react > minimatch 3.1.5 or 9.0.9
advisories.why: Lint tools only: eslint and its plugins match this repository's file names against the patterns of its own configuration while they lint the sources. The running site loads none of them, and no request, page or route reaches minimatch. The fix is minimatch 11.0.1 only, which no release of this eslint toolchain takes yet, so this waits for its releases.
